review_method.coherence_scale: 0 = cut/incomprehensible; 1 = partly understandable but missing context; 2 = self-contained complete idea
review_method.grounding_scale: 0 = no answering evidence; 1 = partial evidence or a missing condition; 2 = sufficient evidence and traceable source
review_method.notes: Scores were assigned from chunk text, not cosine score. Equivalent evidence can receive grounding credit even when strict gold-quote matching fails. No strategy parameter was changed after reviewing test results.

metadata.scope: 5 test questions x top-3 x 3 strategies
metadata.useful_fields: document_id/source/page support traceability; venue/year/method/document_type/language support trusted filters.
metadata.limitation: Document-level metadata cannot distinguish sections within a page, and a correct filter cannot recover a relevant chunk that semantic ranking misses.

filter_compliance.observed_impact: B and C had identical Hit@1/Hit@3 because the unfiltered B results for these scoped questions were already within the requested metadata range.

strategy_selection.predeclared_rule: Highest dev Evidence Hit@3, then dev Hit@1, then grounding, coherence, and resource use.
strategy_selection.reason: All strategies tie on the first criterion; A wins the second criterion. Coherence and resource use are later tie-breakers and therefore do not override dev Hit@1.
